The '''Jalin system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] known as the [[Jalinese knife]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|136|Jalinese knife}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Jalinese knife]]|system=Jalin [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jalin [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-11.<ref name="TEA" />
